sentences.text:
Akkireddy Karteek Kumar vs State Of Telangana on 19 October,
2023

Author: J.K. Maheshwari
Bench: J.K. Maheshwari

In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Original Jurisdiction
 Transfer Petition (Criminal) No. 284 Of 2021
 Akkireddy Karteek Kumar & Ors. Petitioner(s)
 Versus
 State Of Telangana & Anr. Respondent(s)
 Order

This transfer petition is filed seeking transfer of Complaint Case No.NIL of 2020 under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, 3 and 4 Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, filed as Cr.No./FIR No.
438 of 2020 dated 28.11.2020 lodged by the complainant (wife) of petitioner No. 1 which is pending in the Court of II Additional Judicial Magistrate of first class at Kothaguden, Telangana.

entities.text: II Additional Judicial Magistrate of first class at Kothaguden, Telangana
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The transfer has been sought from Kothaguden, Telangana to Visakhapatnam, Andhra Pradesh, on the ground that petitioner Nos. 2 and 3 are old aged and petitioner No. 2 is suffering from ailment and having problem to join the proceedings physically before the Court which is trying the case.

After hearing learned counsel for the parties and TRANSFER PETITION (CRIMINAL) NO. 284 OF 2021 considering the facts and circumstances of the case in which the complainant (wife) lodged the complaint at Kothaguden, we are not inclined to transfer the said case.
Needless to observe that petitioner Nos. 2 and 3 shall appear virtually before the Court which is trying the case.

It is further made clear here that as and when request is made by petitioner No.1 for virtual appearance that may be ordinarily accepted until the presence of petitioner No. 1 is required necessarily.
With the aforesaid observations, this transfer petition is dismissed.

., J.
[ J.K. MAHESHWARI ] ., J.
